propositions: A close that succeeds durably commits but fails to append the completion signature silently downgrades the ticket and returns exit 0 with no programmatic marker of the loss
The signature append failure handler catches SigningError and prints stderr without reporting the outcome in the return payload, making the loss undetectable to callers
The return payload must carry a completion_signature field with signed, cause, and error keys so callers can detect and branch on signature outcomes
The completion_signature field must be optional and absent for non-close transitions and for idea->closed transitions which are not completions
All three public surfaces (library transition(), CLI --output json, and MCP transition_ticket) must thread the completion_signature marker through to callers
The stderr message must clearly state the close landed and only the signature failed, not misleadingly present the lock timeout as a failed close
